name: Attest TimeSpace export checkpoint

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Register TimeSpace export checkpoint]
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

jobs:
  receipt:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Download independently uploaded checkpoint
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "infdahai/zenQuant"
          repository="infdahai/zenQuant"
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$RUN_ID" > provider-run.json
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/artifacts" > artifacts.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, pathlib
          payload = json.loads(pathlib.Path("artifacts.json").read_text())
          suffix = f"-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}"
          matches = [
              item for item in payload["artifacts"]
              if item["name"].startswith("time-space-export-checkpoint-")
              and item["name"].endswith(suffix) and not item["expired"]
          ]
          if len(matches) != 1:
              raise SystemExit("exact checkpoint artifact not found")
          pathlib.Path("artifact.json").write_text(json.dumps(matches[0]))
          pathlib.Path("artifact-id").write_text(str(matches[0]["id"]))
          cutoff = matches[0]["name"].removeprefix("time-space-export-checkpoint-").removesuffix(suffix)
          pathlib.Path("checkpoint-path").write_text(
              f"config/research/registrations/time_space_exports/{cutoff}/"
              "time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json"
          )
          PY
          artifact_id=$(<artifact-id)
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/artifacts/$artifact_id/zip" > checkpoint.zip
          unzip -q checkpoint.zip -d checkpoint-artifact
          manifest=$(find checkpoint-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json)
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$manifest" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
          printf 'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST=%s\n' "$manifest" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CHECKPOINT_LOGICAL_PATH=%s\n' "$(<checkpoint-path)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          generator_run=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["generator_provider_run_id"])' "$manifest")
          cutoff=$(basename "$(dirname "$(<checkpoint-path)")")
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$generator_run/artifacts" > generator-artifacts.json
          python - "$generator_run" "$cutoff" <<'PY'
          import json, pathlib, sys
          run_id, cutoff = sys.argv[1:]
          payload = json.loads(pathlib.Path("generator-artifacts.json").read_text())
          name = f"time-space-export-{cutoff}-{run_id}"
          matches = [item for item in payload["artifacts"] if item["name"] == name and not item["expired"]]
          if len(matches) != 1:
              raise SystemExit("exact generator artifact not found")
          pathlib.Path("generator-artifact-id").write_text(str(matches[0]["id"]))
          pathlib.Path("generator-artifact.json").write_text(json.dumps(matches[0]))
          PY
          generator_artifact_id=$(<generator-artifact-id)
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/artifacts/$generator_artifact_id/zip" > generator.zip
          unzip -q generator.zip -d generator-artifact
          export_file=$(find generator-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export.json)
          provenance_file=$(find generator-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json)
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$export_file" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$provenance_file" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
          printf 'GENERATOR_EXPORT=%s\nGENERATOR_PROVENANCE=%s\n' \
            "$export_file" "$provenance_file" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build receipt from provider and artifact evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python scripts/build_time_space_export_receipt.py \
            --manifest "$ARTIFACT_MANIFEST" \
            --manifest-path "$CHECKPOINT_LOGICAL_PATH" \
            --provider-run-json provider-run.json \
            --artifact-json artifact.json \
            --generator-export "$GENERATOR_EXPORT" \
            --generator-provenance "$GENERATOR_PROVENANCE" \
            --generator-artifact-json generator-artifact.json \
            --output time_space_export_registration_receipt.json
          mkdir time-space-registration-bundle
          cp time_space_export_registration_receipt.json \
            time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_export_registration_receipt_v1.json
          cp "$GENERATOR_EXPORT" time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_shadow_export.json
          cp "$GENERATOR_PROVENANCE" \
            time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: time-space-export-receipt-${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          path: time-space-registration-bundle
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
